title: P0: Navigate to Logs from span hover icon in trace tree
verifies: Hovering a span row in the trace tree reveals a View Logs icon; clicking it navigates to /logs with a span-scoped query

title: P1: Navigate to Logs from sidebar toolbar View Logs button
verifies: Selecting a span opens the TraceDetailsSidebar in standalone mode with a View Logs button; clicking it navigates to /logs

title: P2: Verify URL query contains correct trace/span identifiers
verifies: After per-span log navigation, the decoded URL query parameter contains both trace_id and span_id field names with non-empty values

title: P2: Verify default field names are used (no undefined fallback)
verifies: After navigation, the decoded query uses default field names 'span_id' and 'trace_id', never the literal string 'undefined'
